import sys
objs=[]
def add(s):
    objs.append(s if isinstance(s,bytes) else s.encode('latin1'))
# 1 Catalog, 2 Pages, 3 Page, 4 Widget annotation
add('<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>')
add('<< /Type /Pages /Kids [3 0 R] /Count 1 >>')
add('<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 200 200] /Annots [4 0 R] /Resources << >> /Contents 5 0 R >>')
add('<< /Type /Annot /Subtype /Widget /FT /Btn /T (x) /TU (tip) /Rect [10 10 100 50] /F 4 >>')
add('<< /Length 0 >>\nstream\n\nendstream')
out=b'%PDF-1.4\n%\xe2\xe3\xcf\xd3\n'
offsets=[0]
for i,o in enumerate(objs,1):
    offsets.append(len(out))
    out += f'{i} 0 obj\n'.encode()+o+b'\nendobj\n'
xref=len(out)
out += f'xref\n0 {len(objs)+1}\n'.encode()+b'0000000000 65535 f \n'
for off in offsets[1:]: out += f'{off:010d} 00000 n \n'.encode()
out += f'trailer\n<< /Size {len(objs)+1} /Root 1 0 R >>\nstartxref\n{xref}\n%%EOF\n'.encode()
open('/workspace/poc1.pdf','wb').write(out)
print(len(out))
